name: Trim Prime from Glossy Existing - QT3, Brush
_demonstration_note: Repaint context. Same module list as bare-wood scenario but the substrate_condition=glossy_existing in the ctx skips MDF edge seal AND knot spot prime (neither applies to a previously-painted surface). The bonding-primer material system is referenced for the apply step (vs PVA primer for new construction). Caulk joints and fastener fill in MOD_PREP_TRIM_INITIAL still fire because RP work often needs touch-ups even on previously-finished trim. This scenario demonstrates how the new architecture handles RP variants of the same physical surface with no additional spec authoring — just a different scenario file.
